plainTranslation: Their old wounds and hard-won gentleness work smoothly with how freely you present yourself and enter situations.

summaryDeep: Their old wounds and hard-won gentleness work smoothly with how freely you present yourself and enter situations. You can be visibly yourself around their tender places without either of you bracing. Gentleness here costs neither of you much.
